summary: Admitting money service businesses reverses a policy exclusion for a segment that is cash-intensive, high-velocity and remits globally including to higher-risk jurisdictions. Existing monitoring scenarios do not cover this activity and a dedicated scenario set is only planned. Enhanced due diligence and quarterly agent reviews are proposed but not yet operational.

dimensions.narrative: Existing account product for a very different usage profile.
MSBs are a policy-excluded, inherently higher-risk segment.
Cash deposits and wires at high velocity with no covering scenario.
No third party is involved in this change.
New licensing verification and quarterly agent reviews.

claims.text: Monitoring coverage must be mapped before launch; partial coverage needs a compensating control and committee condition.
